rationale: The agent executed a write (modified order #W5061109) without first confirming the change with the user, violating the requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. There is no clear user authentication step shown beyond the supplied name/ZIP, which is insufficient per policy. The agent also stated specific refund amounts, product specs, and payment method usage (PayPal) without showing supporting tool outputs, and asserted that no further modifications or cancellations can be made without evidence. While the requested change appears to have been made and at a lower price, the process did not adhere to required policy steps, so the conversation fails the pass bar.
